definitions.explanation: A person's outward appearance, especially in terms of clothing and grooming. Often used when commenting on whether someone is well- or poorly-dressed.

examples.japanese: {身|み}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To pay attention to one's appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦きちんとした→きちんとした：17284_kichintoshita⟧{身|み}なり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the interview in neat attire.

examples.japanese: {身|み}なり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だらしない→だらしない：10369_darashinai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{第一印象|だいいちいんしょう}→第一印象：19299_daiichiinshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If your appearance is sloppy, it can make a bad first impression.

notes:
Focuses specifically on clothing and grooming rather than facial features or body shape. Often appears in contexts about social expectations and professionalism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}なり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (pay attention to one's appearance)
- {身|み}なり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (tidy up one's appearance)
- ⟦きちんとした→きちんとした：17284_kichintoshita⟧{身|み}なり (neat appearance)
- {身|み}なり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦だらしない→だらしない：10369_darashinai⟧ (sloppy appearance)
- ⟦みすぼらしい→みすぼらしい：07672_misuborashii⟧{身|み}なり (shabby appearance)
